recommendation: Keep the audit commit and resolve the post-removal design through CBCC/Security/FHIR-I, likely via FHIR-53535 or an equivalent tracker, before updating core Consent and any regenerated diagrams.
issue_request: FHIR-46021 is Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent and requested a Consent.provisionReference element referencing Permission, with an invariant making provisionReference and Consent.provision mutually exclusive.
initial_application: Git commit 101d02d207 initially added ppc-1 and Consent.provisionReference to source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml, but current source has both blocks only inside XML comments.
additional_context: Consent is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, while Permission has no active fhir.ini resource entry and source/permission was deleted by PR #3991. Later Triaged Jira FHIR-53535 says the Permission-based provision capability was removed when Permission moved to an incubator IG and proposes restoring it with an extension.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reinstating provisionReference would point core Consent at a non-core Permission resource and bypass the unresolved cross-artifact design; editing only the stale Consent SVG would not address the authoritative source.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue says ppc-1 should only forbid both provisionReference and provision, not require one; currently moot because ppc-1 is commented out with provisionReference.
Triaged follow-up proposes restoring Permission-based Consent provisions through an extension after Permission moved out of core.
Applied Permission clarification described Consent.provisionReference before the later core Permission removal.
